unitemized.reason: The recommendation is only needed when the agent judges a scenario uncovered. That condition can't be observed, so no applies_when predicate can express it.
This schema defines a 'design' artifact, so the 'no design artifact in the schema' case never happens in this workflow. The condition also can't be written as a predicate.
Whether a design decision was contradicted is the agent's own judgement and can't be observed. The warning can't be tied to a checkable condition.
The recommendation depends on a design contradiction the agent judges for itself. It can't be observed, so applies_when can't express it.
Whether a code-pattern deviation is 'significant' is a subjective call. The suggestion can't be tied to an observable predicate.
The recommendation depends on a significant pattern deviation found by judgement. It can't be observed, so applies_when can't express it.
Which checks were skipped is decided inside the agent's verification. There is no fact or predicate that identifies skipped checks to compare against the 'Not verified (<reason>)' cells.
Whether every check in a dimension was skipped can't be observed from the run facts, so there is no applies_when predicate for it.
This is a reasoning rule for the final assessment (treat partial checks as skipped). Which checks were partially verified isn't observable.
This only applies when the deltas contain REMOVED or RENAMED requirements. The reference language has no predicate over delta section types, so the condition can't be expressed.
